name: signal-hud-breadcrumb
description: M19 U1 acceptance (X-rider W2): signal was the thinnest 'rich' adapter — it overrode only deliver_card + edit_message, so the HUD breadcrumb degraded to stacked plain prose. U1 gave signal a native deliver_breadcrumb (render.rs). signal is edit-capable, so the Task HUD now runs LIVE: it posts ONE breadcrumb chip at the first tool call and edits that chip in place on every later frame instead of stacking prose. The harness models signal's real edit-in-place deliver_breadcrumb via model_rich_breadcrumbs; replay.rs asserts exactly one breadcrumb post + >=1 edit, all targeting that single anchor. See README.md.
